_comment: Deterministic fault injection, keyed by case. This is how the reliability requirements are exercised by a fixture rather than only by a unit test with a patched function: FIN-004 genuinely cannot reach the purchasing system, and the run has to survive that and say so. Profiles are declarative so a reviewer can see which failure each case exercises without reading code.

profiles.timeout_always: Every attempt exceeds the tool timeout. Exercises the retry ceiling and the missing-evidence path.
profiles.transient_then_success: The first attempt fails with a retryable error; the next succeeds. Exercises recovery inside the retry budget.
profiles.permanent_error: Fails with a non-retryable error. Must not be retried, because the budget is needed by later controls.
profiles.not_found: Returns no record. Distinct from an error: absence is evidence, and it produces a hold rather than a failure.
